Just to confirm, if you do

file <- "~/Dropbox/PHD/personal/analysis/models/anova_simple/anova_simple.stan"
mtime <- file.info(file)$mtime
md5 <- tools::md5sum(file)
file.rda <- "~/Dropbox/PHD/personal/analysis/models/anova_simple/anova_simple.rda"

and then which of these lines returns NA or TRUE?

!file.exists(file.rda)
(mtime.rda <- file.info(file.rda)$mtime) <  mtime
mtime.rda < as.POSIXct(packageDescription("rstan")$Date)
mtime.rda > rstan:::rstan_load_time
!is(obj <- readRDS(file.rda), "stanmodel")
!rstan:::is_sm_valid(obj)
!is.null(writeLines(obj@model_code, con = tf <- tempfile()))
md5 != tools::md5sum(tf)

Ben
